item.name: Pet Box
item.description: Pet Box is the first transfer station players see, used for claiming pets brought over from Pet Simulator X.

item.name: Garg Machine (Huge-A-Tron)
item.task: Create Huge or Gargantuan machine eggs
item.inputCost: Small Exclusive pets or listed machine requirements
item.output: Huge Egg or refreshed Gargantuan Machine reward pool
item.unlockAvailability: Castle machine; reward lineup can refresh
item.warning: Consumes valuable Exclusive pets or machine inputs.
item.description: Garg Machine, also known through Huge-A-Tron context, is an expensive pet-conversion station for chasing bigger exclusive rewards.

item.name: Pets Equipped
item.inputCost: Upgrade cost shown at the machine
item.description: Pets Equipped is a core team-size station, useful as soon as stronger farming depends on having more pets active.

item.name: Egg Machine
item.inputCost: Upgrade cost shown at the machine
item.description: Egg Machine helps hatching sessions scale by raising how many eggs a player can open at once.

item.name: Gold Pets Machine
item.location: Area #10 - Mine; also available from Tech Spawn machine hub context
item.description: Gold Pets Machine turns normal pets into gold versions, making it one of the first major pet-upgrade stops.

item.name: Fuse Machine
item.description: Fuse Machine is for turning extra pets into a new pet result instead of keeping every duplicate in inventory.

item.name: Rainbow Machine
item.location: Area #31 - Desert Pyramids; also available from Tech Spawn machine hub context
item.inputCost: Gold pets selected for rainbow conversion
item.description: Rainbow Machine is the next pet-upgrade step after gold, turning gold pets into stronger rainbow versions.

item.name: Evolve Machine
item.task: Convert Huge pets into evolved variants
item.warning: Evolution cannot be undone and the Huge pets used are gone.
item.description: Evolve Machine is for endgame players who want evolved Huge variants and the Exclusive Daycare diamond bonus, not a casual pet upgrade.

item.name: Card Combination Machine
item.description: Card Combination Machine handles card-to-pet conversion without needing a normal area-station stop.

item.name: Upgrade Potions Machine
item.description: Upgrade Potions Machine turns lower potion tiers into stronger ones, which also makes spare low-tier boosts useful later.

item.name: Upgrade Enchants Machine
item.inputCost: Lower-tier enchant books and machine cost
item.description: Upgrade Enchants Machine is the normal route for pushing tiered enchant books into stronger versions.

item.name: Upgrade Fruits Machine
item.description: Upgrade Fruits Machine is the fruit-blending station for turning regular fruit stacks into stronger fruit variants.

item.name: Magic Machine
item.description: Magic Machine spends magic materials for selected crafted items after players reach Haunted Mansion.

item.name: Item Creator
item.inputCost: Quest progress or listed item requirements
item.description: Item Creator turns quest work into items, so it belongs with crafting stations rather than normal pet machines.

item.name: Forge Machine
item.description: Forge Machine is a later item-combination station for turning eligible materials into parent items.

item.name: Empower Enchants
item.description: Empower Enchants is a short-session boost station for books you already plan to use.

item.name: Enchant Essence
item.description: Enchant Essence converts books into the essence used by the empower system.

item.name: XP Potion Machine
item.inputCost: Recipe ingredients shown at the machine
item.output: Ultimate, Mastery, Huge, or Titanic XP potions
item.description: XP Potion Machine creates direct-progress potions for expensive targets such as Huge pets, Titanic pets, masteries, and ultimates.

item.name: Prison P (Prison Preston)
item.description: Prison Preston is a key-conversion station tied to the Prison area route.

item.name: Seashell Machine
item.description: Seashell Machine is a gift-crafting station for turning seashell resources into Summer Gifts.

item.name: Combine-O-Matic
item.location: Event worlds and Fantasy World contexts
item.inputCost: Event or world items listed by the active machine
item.output: Higher-tier items, Huge pets, Titanic pets, or Gargantuan pets
item.warning: Recipes change by event and should not be treated as permanent.
item.description: Combine-O-Matic is a recurring limited crafting station, so the row tracks the machine role without turning old recipes into permanent card text.

item.name: Daycare
item.inputCost: Pets enrolled for a daycare timer
item.description: Daycare turns unused pets into timed reward runs while they are enrolled.

item.name: Comet Shower Machine
item.output: Comet Shower event in an area
item.description: Comet Shower Machine starts a comet event when players want a burst of breakable-style rewards.

item.name: Quest Machines
item.location: Area #29 - Desert Village; Area #60 - Rainbow River; Area #111 - Oasis Ruins
item.inputCost: Daily, 3 Day, or Weekly quest work
item.description: Quest Machines group daily, 3 Day, and weekly quest boards into one route-focused row so players can find the board they need.

item.name: Exclusive Daycare
item.task: Earn diamonds from Huge and Titanic pets
item.inputCost: Huge and Titanic pets inserted into Exclusive Daycare
item.warning: Only commit valuable pets when you understand the daycare timer and payoff.
item.description: Exclusive Daycare is a late-game diamond station for players who can spare Huge or Titanic pets for reward time.

item.name: Area Surge
item.inputCost: Machine activation requirement shown in game
item.description: Area Surge is a coin-focused boost station for charging an area when currency farming is the goal.

item.name: Boost Exchange
item.output: Diamond, drop chance, and egg luck boost time
item.description: Boost Exchange spends Millionaire Bucks for temporary farming and hatching boosts after players reach Silver City.

item.name: Trainer Preston
item.description: Trainer Preston is a quest station tied to catching pets rather than crafting or converting inventory items.

item.name: Wings Upgrade
item.inputCost: Wing upgrade requirement shown in game
item.description: Wings Upgrade is a world-specific progression station for improving the wings system.

item.name: Woodcutting Preston
item.description: Woodcutting Preston is a quest station for the woodcutting route in later Elemental progression.

item.name: Index Machine
item.location: Area #1 - Spawn; Area #76 - Haunted Graveyard; Tech Spawn context
item.description: Index Machine is a collection-management stop for checking how many different pets a player has collected.

item.name: Super Computer
item.location: Trading Plaza; Area #100 - Tech Spawn; Void Spawn; Area #240 - Fantasy Spawn
item.inputCost: Area or rebirth access; Trading Plaza requires Rebirth 4 and Void Spawn requires Rebirth 8
item.output: Machine access across World 1, World 2, World 3, and Fantasy context
item.description: Super Computer is the main machine hub, useful when players want machine access without walking back through older worlds.
